prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Houston for AC repair?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single “best” — it depends on your neighborhood, the specific problem, and whether you want speed, low price, or a long-term service relationship. Two large, widely used companies in Houston are John Moore and ARS/Rescue Rooter, but many independent local shops also get excellent results.

If you tell me your ZIP code and whether this is an emergency (no cooling now) or a routine repair, I can pull up 3–5 top-rated, nearby companies and recent customer ratings.

How to pick the best company for your situation
- Licensing & insurance: make sure the tech/company shows a Texas HVAC license (TACLA/TDLR where applicable) and carries liability insurance.  
- Certifications: NATE-certified technicians are a plus.  
- Transparent estimates: written estimate that separates parts, labor, and diagnostic fees.  
- Warranties: ask about parts and labor warranty and any guarantees on the repair.  
- Reviews & reputation: check recent Google/Yelp/BBB reviews for response time and whether problems returned.  
- Availability: confirm emergency or same-day service if you need it.  
- Price vs. value: cheaper isn’t always better — ask what they diagnose and why, and whether repair or replacement is best.

Questions to ask a company/technician
- Are you licensed and insured? What’s your TACLA or state license number?  
- Are your techs NATE-certified?  
- Do you charge a diagnostic fee, and is it waived if we proceed with the repair?  
- What warranty do you offer on parts and labor?  
- Can you provide references or recent customer testimonials?

Red flags
- High-pressure “must replace now” sales tactics without proper diagnostics.  
- No written estimate or vague scope of work.  
- Unmarked vans and technicians who won’t show ID or license.  
- Many recent one-star reviews citing repeat failures.

If you give your ZIP code and a brief description (no cooling at all, strange noises, higher bills, age of system), I’ll list 3–5 top-rated local HVAC companies and a short note on why each might be a good fit.
